analogy.rationale: NR5A2 (LRH-1) is a nuclear receptor with limited expression in most of these cell lines, so an inverse agonist should elicit little transcriptional change; other nuclear receptor ligands are the closest reference classes but act on different receptors and thus share only low-to-medium similarity.
